main_text.l: Vult enim Deus Ecclesiam suam conspici in mundo,
eamque agnosci ex his sacris signis, vt milites agnos-
cuntur ex tesseris militaribus, & oues ex notis quas eis
pastor inurit. Iubet Iudæos circuncidi & Christianos bap-
tizari: alienos arcet ab esu agni Pesah. Vult suum regnum
à synagoga Satanæ discerni.1. Propter gloriam suam.2.
Propter nostram consolationem & salutem. Sicut enim non
vult se confundi cum idolis: sic etiam non vult popu-
lum suum confundi cum regno Diaboli.

The right-hand references are copied as printed; the reading of "1.cc.12.13." is uncertain. Doubtful readings: "crediturus" (printed form partly unclear), "do-ctrinæ" (the first letters of the hyphen-broken word are hard to read), "vescendū" (the printed form is unclear). Long s is printed as f in the scan and is transcribed here as s.
